titre: Applying for a middle school or high school grant
resume: Automatic assessment at enrollment or an application between September 1 and October 15, 2026: income limits, amounts, the tax notice to provide and the rules when parents are separated or have shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: The bourse de collège (middle school grant) and the bourse de lycée (high school grant) help low-income families pay school costs. They are paid in three installments during the year. For 2026-2027, what counts is the reference tax income (revenu fiscal de référence) on the 2026 tax notice (2025 income). The simplest way is to agree to automatic assessment of grant eligibility when you enroll your child. This entry also recaps the key points of enrolling in middle school (collège).
quiEstConcerne: Families of a middle or high school student attending a public school, a state-contracted private school (privé sous contrat) or the Cned (national distance-learning center).
Parents of a student starting 6e (first year of collège) or high school.
Separated parents: only one of the two can apply.
aSavoir: Middle school grant 2026-2027: €40, €112 or €175 per term depending on income. Income limits (2025 income): €18,488 for 1 dependent child, €22,754 for 2, €27,020 for 3, €31,286 for 4, €35,553 for 5.
High school grant 2026-2027: 6 levels (échelons), from €168 to €357 per term. For 1 dependent child, the limit for level 1 is €22,037. The official simulator tells you your level.

Shared residence (middle school grant): only one parent submits the application. If both submit one, both are declared inadmissible. A statement in which the other parent waives their right to apply is not accepted.

Agreeing to automatic assessment at enrollment counts as an application for the rest of the child's time in middle and high school. Without this agreement, you must apply again every year, even if the child had a grant the year before.
Paid in 3 installments, usually at the end of December, end of March and end of June.

Appeals: in middle school, 2 months after the notice. In high school, 15 full days (jours francs) after a refusal, to the rectorat (regional education authority), then 2 months if refused a second time.

Collected from the school office or filled in online with EduConnect if the school offers it.

Proof of address and ID photos
documents.detail: For enrollment, according to the school's list.

etapes.titre: Estimate your entitlement with the simulator
etapes.detail: With your 2026 tax notice and the number of dependent children. The simulator can be reached from the service-public.gouv.fr pages.

etapes.titre: At enrollment, agree to automatic assessment
etapes.detail: Online with EduConnect or on the paper file. There is then nothing else to do.

etapes.titre: Otherwise, apply between September 1 and October 15, 2026
etapes.detail: Online with EduConnect, or on a paper form at the school office.
Full 2026 tax notice (both for unmarried couples), RIB, signed form, residence judgment if you are separated. With shared residence, agree in advance on which parent applies.

etapes.titre: Submit the file before the deadline
etapes.detail: Ask for a receipt or note the date you submitted it.
If refused, respect the appeal deadline given above.
